source: Real FRA card list (280 cards). Grades are heuristic except 49 hand-written ones. Import 17Lands data to replace them.
scale: 0-5 limited grades (3.0 = solid playable, 4.0 = premium, 4.5+ = bomb)
rubric: Instant-speed unconditional removal at 3 mana or less - kills a prepared creature before the copy is cast
In-college prepared creature with a real body
Any other removal - every deck wants 4+ interaction
Empower Jace 3 on a relevant body (~half a card)
Out-of-college prepared creature - rate the body only
Threshold cards outside U/B - read the threshold text as absent
Face-damage payoffs outside a genuinely fast B/R - the format's biggest trap

Denzilore Fatehold.note: 4-mana 3/4 flash flier; +1/+1 counter on your team whenever you scry or surveil. Best of the five sphinxes.

Aerid Konstrari.note: 4-mana 5/4 flier that makes a Heartwood on entry AND death, with a mana sink.

Ingris Stingerquill.note: Your attackers each ping every opponent. Turns a wide board into a clock.

Uldaros Theorix.note: Graveyard payoff; needs threshold-level setup to be a true bomb.

Kwia Vigorbloom.note: Lotus tokens. Ritual mana is worst in the slowest deck - weakest of the five.

Overwrite the Multiverse.note: Cantripping wipe. Sealed sleeper. RARITY UNVERIFIED.

Vigorbloom Vanguard.note: Vigorbloom signpost; heals and adds counters.

Prudent Fateseer.note: Fatehold prepared: makes a 2/2 and surveils. Premium common rate.

Theorist's Proxy.note: Empower Jace 3 - roughly half a card.

Master of Barbs.note: The payoff that makes Stingerquill work at all.

Stingcaster Mage.note: 2-mana haste body; gives an instant/sorcery flashback on entry. Red Snapcaster. RARITY UNVERIFIED.

Graft Surgeon.note: Keeps counters around after creatures die.

Fatehold Annex.note: Land. Taps for white or blue. Enters tapped unless you control a planeswalker - a Jace token counts, but one entering the same turn does not. The set's only common fixing, and only for the five allied pairs.

Theorix Annex.note: Land. Taps for blue or black. Enters tapped unless you control a planeswalker - a Jace token counts, but one entering the same turn does not. The set's only common fixing, and only for the five allied pairs.

Stingerquill Annex.note: Land. Taps for black or red. Enters tapped unless you control a planeswalker - a Jace token counts, but one entering the same turn does not. The set's only common fixing, and only for the five allied pairs.

Konstrari Annex.note: Land. Taps for red or green. Enters tapped unless you control a planeswalker - a Jace token counts, but one entering the same turn does not. The set's only common fixing, and only for the five allied pairs.

Vigorbloom Annex.note: Land. Taps for green or white. Enters tapped unless you control a planeswalker - a Jace token counts, but one entering the same turn does not. The set's only common fixing, and only for the five allied pairs.

fixing.note: Every dual in FRA is allied. There is no enemy-colour land at any rarity.
fixing.portal_rare: A cycle of 5 rare Echoverse/Portal slowlands, also allied pairs only.
fixing.heartwood: Artifact token, {T}: add {R} or {G}. Fixes an R or G splash ONLY - not any colour.
fixing.lotus: Kwia Vigorbloom (mythic) makes Lotus tokens: tap and sacrifice for three mana of one colour.
